title_tag: 失禁中完赛，中产网红运动的体面碎了一地！HYROX北京站陷入巨大争议—— BBC外刊讲解第1169天
h1: 失禁中完赛，中产网红运动的体面碎了一地！HYROX北京站陷入巨大争议

headline.en_html: HYROX Beijing faces backlash after Aussie athlete continues race despite soiling herself
headline.zh: HYROX北京站因澳大利亚选手失禁后仍继续参赛而遭抨击

notes.en: a strong negative reaction by a large number of people to a social or political development
notes.ctx: 标题里的这个词定下全文基调：不是“有争议”，而是公众对主办方决定的强烈反弹。
notes.ex1: The company faced a fierce backlash after announcing massive layoffs. 公司宣布大规模裁员后遭到强烈反对。
notes.ex2: The new policy sparked a backlash from environmental groups across the country. 新政策引发了全国环保团体的强烈反弹。

notes.en: an informal word for an Australian person
notes.ctx: 标题用口语化的 Aussie 指代澳大利亚选手，是英文新闻标题为节省篇幅的惯用写法。
notes.ex1: The Aussie couple spent their honeymoon traveling across Southeast Asia. 这对澳大利亚夫妇在东南亚各地旅行度蜜月。
notes.ex2: He's a proud Aussie who loves his cricket and barbies. 他是个自豪的澳大利亚人，热爱板球和烧烤。

paragraphs.en_html: The organisers of a viral sporting event in Beijing have faced <mark class="voc">backlash</mark> and criticism after an Australian woman was allowed to continue competing after soiling herself. Athlete Joanna Wietrzyk was participating in the global indoor fitness race HYROX in the Chinese capital at the weekend when she suffered <mark class="voc">a bout of</mark> <mark class="voc">faecal</mark> <mark class="voc">incontinence</mark>. Wietrzyk was allowed to finish the course and won her event, with videos and photos posted online showing her continuing through <mark class="voc">demanding</mark> exercises and using <mark class="voc">communal</mark> equipment while visibly soiled.
paragraphs.zh: 北京一场迅速走红的体育赛事，其主办方近日遭到抨击与批评。起因是一名澳大利亚女子在失禁后仍被允许继续参赛。上周末，运动员乔安娜·维特日克在中国首都参加全球室内健身赛HYROX时，遭遇大便失禁。维特日克获准跑完全程，并赢得所在组别冠军。网上流传的视频和照片显示，她在明显弄脏身体的情况下，仍继续完成高强度项目，并使用公共器材。

notes.en: a strong negative reaction by a large number of people to a social or political development
notes.ctx: 开篇即点明主办方承受的压力来自公众的强烈批评，而不是赛事本身的成绩问题。
notes.ex1: The company faced a fierce backlash after announcing massive layoffs. 公司宣布大规模裁员后遭到强烈反对。
notes.ex2: The new policy sparked a backlash from environmental groups across the country. 新政策引发了全国环保团体的强烈反弹。

notes.en: a short period of a particular illness or unpleasant feeling
notes.zh: 一阵，一次（疾病等的发作）
notes.ctx: 一次突然发作的大便失禁——a bout of 强调这是突发的一次，而非长期病症。
notes.ex1: She was sidelined by a bout of flu just before the championship. 她在锦标赛前夕因一阵流感而无法参赛。
notes.ex2: He suffered a bout of dizziness and had to sit down. 他一阵头晕，不得不坐下来。

notes.en: relating to faeces (solid waste matter from the body)
notes.ctx: 英式拼写，修饰后面的 incontinence，指明失禁的性质。
notes.ex1: The laboratory tested water samples for faecal contamination. 实验室检测了水样中的粪便污染。
notes.ex2: Faecal bacteria were found on the restaurant's kitchen surfaces. 餐厅厨房表面发现了粪便细菌。

notes.en: the inability to control the release of urine or faeces from the body
notes.ctx: 医学用词，指无法自主控制排便，是整场争议的生理起点。
notes.ex1: The condition can cause urinary incontinence in older adults. 这种疾病可能导致老年人尿失禁。
notes.ex2: She sought medical help for incontinence after childbirth. 她因产后失禁而寻求医疗帮助。

notes.en: requiring a lot of effort, skill, or energy
notes.zh: 费力的，高强度的，要求高的
notes.ctx: 指 HYROX 那些极耗体力的比赛项目，说明她是在高强度运动中继续完赛的。
notes.ex1: Being a surgeon is a demanding job that leaves little time for rest. 外科医生是一份高强度的工作，几乎没有休息时间。
notes.ex2: The training program is physically demanding and not suitable for beginners. 该训练计划对体能要求很高，不适合初学者。

notes.en: shared by or used by members of a group or community
notes.ctx: 关键细节：器材是共用的，这正是后文卫生争议与“双重标准”指控的落点。
notes.ex1: The residents share a communal garden behind the building. 居民们共用楼后的一座花园。
notes.ex2: Communal kitchens in hostels can be a source of conflict among travelers. 青年旅舍的公共厨房可能成为旅客之间产生矛盾的源头。

paragraphs.en_html: Wietrzyk, who is a HYROX world record holder, was invited to compete at the Beijing event. In just four months, Joanna Wietrzyk has gone from discovering HYROX to dominating it. “I didn’t even know what HYROX was four months ago,” Wietrzyk admits. But with a background in competitive tennis and <mark class="voc">distance running</mark>, she’s <mark class="voc">adapted</mark> fast.
paragraphs.zh: 维特日克是HYROX世界纪录保持者，此次受邀参加北京站比赛。短短四个月内，乔安娜·维特日克便从初识HYROX，到称霸赛场。“四个月前，我甚至不知道HYROX是什么，”维特日克坦言。但凭借竞技网球和长跑的底子，她适应得很快。

notes.en: the sport of running long races, such as marathons
notes.ctx: 交代她的运动底子——长跑背景解释了她为何能迅速适应 HYROX。
notes.ex1: Distance running requires not only physical endurance but also mental toughness. 长跑不仅需要身体耐力，还需要心理韧性。
notes.ex2: He took up distance running to improve his cardiovascular health. 他开始练长跑以改善心血管健康。

notes.en: to change your behavior or methods to suit a new situation
notes.ctx: 指她从网球、长跑转到 HYROX 后快速上手，四个月便称霸赛场。
notes.ex1: It took her a few months to adapt to the new working environment. 她花了几个月才适应新的工作环境。
notes.ex2: Animals adapt to changing climates through evolution. 动物通过进化来适应不断变化的气候。

paragraphs.en_html: The incident has <mark class="voc">gone viral</mark> on Chinese social media and sparked debate about HYROX’s health and safety standards, as well as athlete responsibility. “She’s so <mark class="voc">selfish</mark> — she kept running the whole way even though she had <mark class="voc">diarrhoea</mark>,” one user on Weibo questioned. “What about the runners behind her?” Another wrote: “The <mark class="voc">host</mark> is ultimately unprofessional!” On Weibo, the <mark class="voc">hashtag</mark> #Hyrox incontinence female competitor has not been punished# has more than 27 million views. An article on the Beijing incident was the most-viewed story on Chinese state media website the Global Times on Monday.
paragraphs.zh: 此事在中国社交媒体上迅速发酵，引发围绕HYROX健康安全标准以及运动员责任的争论。“她太自私了——明明拉肚子还一路跑，”一位微博用户质疑道，“后面的人怎么办？”另一人写道：“主办方终究太不专业了！”微博话题#Hyrox失禁女选手未被处罚#阅读量已超过2700万。《环球时报》周一刊登的一篇关于北京此事的文章，成为中国官方媒体网站上浏览量最高的报道。

notes.en: to spread quickly and widely on the internet
notes.ctx: 指事件从赛场溢出到中文社交媒体，成为公共话题。
notes.ex1: The video of the dancing cat went viral within hours of being posted. 那段猫跳舞的视频发布后几小时内就火了。
notes.ex2: Her speech went viral, generating millions of views overnight. 她的演讲迅速传播，一夜之间获得数百万次观看。

notes.en: caring only about yourself rather than about other people
notes.ctx: 微博网友的指责：只顾自己完赛，不管身后跑者。
notes.ex1: It was selfish of him to keep the information to himself. 他把信息独占，真是自私。
notes.ex2: She accused her colleague of being selfish for taking all the credit. 她指责同事自私，把所有功劳都揽到自己身上。

notes.en: an illness in which waste matter is discharged from the bowels very frequently and in liquid form
notes.ctx: 网友原话里的说法，比正式用语 faecal incontinence 更口语、更具指责意味。
notes.ex1: Travelers to tropical regions often suffer from diarrhoea. 前往热带地区的旅行者常患腹泻。
notes.ex2: The doctor advised him to drink plenty of fluids while he had diarrhoea. 医生建议他腹泻期间多喝水。

notes.en: a person or organization that organizes an event and provides the place for it
notes.ctx: 网友把矛头指向主办方——“主办方终究太不专业了”。
notes.ex1: The host of the conference provided translation services for all attendees. 会议主办方为所有参会者提供了翻译服务。
notes.ex2: The city was chosen as the host of the next Olympic Games. 该城市被选为下届奥运会的主办方。

notes.en: a word or phrase preceded by the symbol # that categorizes posts on social media
notes.ctx: 指 #Hyrox失禁女选手未被处罚# 这一话题标签，阅读量已超 2700 万。
notes.ex1: The campaign used the hashtag #ClimateAction to reach a wider audience. 该活动使用#ClimateAction话题标签来触达更广泛的受众。
notes.ex2: Her tweet with the hashtag #MeToo was shared thousands of times. 她带有#MeToo话题标签的推文被转发了数千次。

paragraphs.en_html: After the race, she <mark class="voc">doubled down</mark> and even shared a <mark class="voc">selfie</mark> on Instagram, which has since been deleted, appearing to show her in a hospital bed. “<mark class="voc">Go hard or go home</mark>…a win is a win.” <mark class="voc">Footage</mark> and images of the incident subsequently spread across social media and fitness <mark class="voc">forums</mark>, with reactions ranging from praise for Wietrzyk’s determination to concerns around <mark class="voc">hygiene</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 赛后，她态度更加强硬，甚至还在Instagram上分享了一张自拍，照片似乎显示她躺在病床上，但该帖后来已被删除。“要么拼尽全力，要么干脆回家……赢了就是赢了。”事件相关视频和图片随后在社交媒体和健身论坛上广泛传播，反应不一：有人称赞维特日克的意志力，也有人担忧卫生问题。

notes.en: to become more firm and determined in a belief or position, especially when facing opposition
notes.zh: 变本加厉，更加坚定，加倍下注
notes.ctx: 赛后不但不道歉，反而发“赢了就是赢了”，态度更硬。
notes.ex1: Despite the criticism, the CEO doubled down on his controversial strategy. 尽管受到批评，CEO仍更加坚定地推行他有争议的策略。
notes.ex2: Instead of apologizing, she doubled down and repeated her accusation. 她没有道歉，反而变本加厉地重复了她的指控。

notes.en: a photograph that you take of yourself, usually with a smartphone
notes.ctx: 指那张疑似病床上的自拍，后来被删除——删帖本身又成了新争议点。
notes.ex1: He took a selfie with the Eiffel Tower in the background. 他拍了一张以埃菲尔铁塔为背景的自拍。
notes.ex2: The actress posted a selfie without makeup, which quickly went viral. 那位女演员发了一张素颜自拍，迅速走红。

notes.en: an expression encouraging someone to give maximum effort or not bother trying at all
notes.zh: 要么拼尽全力，要么干脆回家
notes.ctx: 她用这句健身圈口号为自己辩护，把争议转成“全力以赴”的叙事。
notes.ex1: My coach always told us, "Go hard or go home," before every match. 我的教练每次比赛前都对我们说：“要么拼尽全力，要么干脆回家。”
notes.ex2: She lives by the motto "go hard or go home" and never does anything half-heartedly. 她的座右铭是“要么拼尽全力，要么干脆回家”，做任何事都从不半途而废。

notes.en: film or video recording of a particular event
notes.ctx: 指现场拍下的视频，是事件在健身论坛持续发酵的载体。
notes.ex1: The security footage showed the suspect entering the building at midnight. 监控录像显示嫌疑人午夜进入大楼。
notes.ex2: News channels broadcast footage of the protest from multiple angles. 新闻频道从多个角度播放了抗议活动的视频片段。

notes.en: a website or place where people can exchange ideas and discuss topics
notes.ctx: 健身论坛与社交媒体一起构成舆论场，反应从称赞到担忧卫生都有。
notes.ex1: She found useful advice about marathon training on an online running forum. 她在一个在线跑步论坛上找到了关于马拉松训练的有用建议。
notes.ex2: The company's support forum allows users to help each other solve technical problems. 该公司的支持论坛允许用户互相帮助解决技术问题。

notes.en: practices and conditions that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially cleanliness
notes.ctx: 舆论的另一极：不是道德评判，而是共用器材带来的卫生风险。
notes.ex1: Good personal hygiene is essential for preventing the spread of infections. 良好的个人卫生对预防感染传播至关重要。
notes.ex2: The restaurant was closed down for failing to meet food hygiene standards. 该餐厅因未达到食品卫生标准而被关闭。

paragraphs.en_html: HYROX is a global fitness challenge in which participants race to complete often <mark class="voc">gruelling</mark> stations, including sandbag lunges, burpees, sled pushes and <mark class="voc">rowing</mark>. In a statement, HYROX China said the area was <mark class="voc">decontaminated</mark> after the race had finished. “After the incident, the organising committee immediately closed off and isolated the affected area and track, and completed <mark class="voc">comprehensive</mark> <mark class="voc">disinfection</mark>,” organisers said. “Relevant equipment was removed from the venue, and waste was <mark class="voc">disposed of</mark> <mark class="voc">in accordance with</mark> <mark class="voc">municipal</mark> waste-management standards.” The organisers also said they would replace flooring at the venue to protect future athlete health.
paragraphs.zh: HYROX是一项全球健身挑战赛，参赛者需竞速完成一系列往往极为艰苦的项目，包括沙袋弓步、波比跳、雪橇推和划船。HYROX中国在一份声明中表示，比赛结束后已对相关区域进行净化处理。“事件发生后，组委会第一时间对受影响区域和赛道进行封闭隔离，并完成全面消杀，”主办方表示，“相关器材已撤离场馆，废弃物也按照城市垃圾管理标准处置。”主办方还表示，将更换场馆地板，以保障未来参赛者的健康。

notes.en: extremely tiring and demanding
notes.ctx: 形容 HYROX 那些极耗体力的功能站，为后文“为何不能中途叫停”埋下对照。
notes.ex1: The soldiers underwent a gruelling training regimen that lasted six weeks. 士兵们经历了为期六周的艰苦训练。
notes.ex2: She described the marathon as the most gruelling experience of her life. 她将那次马拉松描述为她一生中最艰苦的经历。

notes.en: the sport or activity of propelling a boat using oars; in fitness, using a rowing machine
notes.ctx: 列举的四个项目之一，划船机是 HYROX 八个功能站中的一项。
notes.ex1: Rowing is a full-body workout that engages both the upper and lower body. 划船是一项锻炼全身的运动，上肢和下肢都能得到训练。
notes.ex2: She spends 30 minutes on the rowing machine every morning. 她每天早上在划船机上练30分钟。

notes.en: to remove dangerous or polluting substances from a place or object
notes.ctx: 主办方的核心说法：赛后已对受影响区域做净化处理。
notes.ex1: Hazardous materials teams were called in to decontaminate the laboratory. 危险品处理小组被召来对实验室进行净化。
notes.ex2: All equipment must be decontaminated before being reused. 所有设备在重新使用前必须经过消毒。

notes.en: including everything or nearly everything that is relevant
notes.ctx: 修饰 disinfection，强调消杀是“全面”的，而非局部擦拭。
notes.ex1: The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the housing market. 该报告对住房市场进行了全面分析。
notes.ex2: The insurance policy offers comprehensive coverage for both home and contents. 该保险政策为房屋和室内财产提供全面保障。

notes.en: the process of cleaning something with a substance that kills bacteria
notes.ctx: 与 decontaminate 呼应，指用杀菌手段清洁场地与器材。
notes.ex1: Regular disinfection of high-touch surfaces helps prevent the spread of viruses. 对高频接触表面进行定期消毒有助于防止病毒传播。
notes.ex2: The hospital upgraded its disinfection procedures after the outbreak. 疫情爆发后，医院升级了消毒流程。

notes.en: to get rid of something, especially in a proper way
notes.ctx: 指废弃物按城市垃圾管理标准处置，回应公众对污染物的担忧。
notes.ex1: Please dispose of your rubbish in the bins provided. 请将垃圾丢入提供的垃圾桶中。
notes.ex2: The company was fined for improperly disposing of chemical waste. 该公司因不当处置化学废弃物而被罚款。

notes.en: in a way that follows a rule, law, or standard
notes.ctx: 声明用这一正式短语强调处置“合规”，是危机公关的典型措辞。
notes.ex1: All employees must act in accordance with the company's code of conduct. 所有员工必须按照公司行为准则行事。
notes.ex2: The building was constructed in accordance with local safety regulations. 该建筑是按照当地安全法规建造的。

notes.en: relating to a town or city or its local government
notes.ctx: 限定标准出自市政层面，等于把责任推给既有规范而非赛事自身。
notes.ex1: The municipal government announced a new recycling program. 市政府宣布了一项新的回收计划。
notes.ex2: Municipal water supplies are tested regularly for contaminants. 市政供水定期进行污染物检测。
